_comment: Persona A, the original one-persona run: decision training only, 3000 steps (10000 until 2026-11-24), the nine report questions (the four original ones until 2026-11-24: run 20261106-152354, 'A-old'). On Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B.

Since 2026-11-24 asks the nine report questions every one-persona experiment asks: main, screen_index, screen_cut_units, main_report_units (shown a trial, 50 samples each) and main_threshold_met, main_threshold_not_met, screen_index_no_trial, screen_cut_units_no_trial, screen_cut_percent_no_trial (no trial, asked once each), every reply started with "{" (reply_prefix) and C shown in report trials (show_neither). Until then it asked the first 4 only, with no reply prefix and C not shown, and so was every run of it before that date. scripts/add_nine_questions.py.

Named one_persona_minimum_threshold.json until 2026-11-24, when it was brought in line with B's file and the other personas: 3000 steps (were 10000), save_optimizer last (was all: every checkpoint kept AdamW's state), run_tag persona-a (was none). Run 20261106-152354 ('A-old', Qwen3-8B) was made with the old values: 10000 steps, the four original questions.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
The data folder is the Qwen3-8B experiment's: trials and answers do not depend on the model.

The untrained model is scored first, as step 0 (baseline_before_training true): Qwen3-1.7B has no base-model score for these prompts. Where a note below names Qwen3-8B or a 16 GB card, or says the untrained model is not scored first, it is the Qwen3-8B file this one was written from: base/persona_a/ in configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B on a 40 GB card (A100 40GB): micro_batch_size 10, gradient_checkpointing false, eval batches 96 (decision 96, introspection 8). Evaluation batches are Qwen3-8B's for this card. The training pass is larger than 8B's where the card allows: one example takes about 0.4 of 8B's activations (28 layers, half the width). Not measured on Qwen3-1.7B. Out of memory in training: micro_batch_size 5, then gradient_checkpointing true. Out of memory in evaluation: eval batches 48.
Run: python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona_qwen3_1.7b/base/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold_a_1.7b_40gb.json
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over minimum_threshold_1500_steps.json (those values are now written out here too):
One persona, decision training only: does faithful self-report emerge from decision training alone? Qwen3-8B (16 GB
card), the paper minimum threshold task, trained only on loose_leaf_tea ('Imagine you are Djedefre'), persona 0 of
data/paper_minimum_threshold/: weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100,
resteep_potential 31; caffeine_content screened at 50% of its range. Extends minimum_threshold_1500_steps.json;
everything not set here is that file's (and so paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json's).
There is no stage two. introspection_training false: the report questions are asked at every checkpoint but never
trained on, so faithfulness (reported vs recovered) and hidden_vs_reported (reported vs the instilled rule) at
each checkpoint come from decision training alone. With one persona there are no folds anyway.
decision_rule: 75% of training trials are decided by the weights alone (both options pass the screen),
12.5% are C (both fail the screen, neither_share) and 12.5% are decided by the screen (one passes, one fails: the
remainder, since both other kinds are at quota). 5000 training trials: 3750 / 625 / 625. 100 validation
trials: 75 weights, 12 C, 13 screen. Estimation trials (what the model is scored on) are drawn as they come.
About half the screen trials would get the same answer without the screen (the passing option also wins on
the weights), so the cut changes the answer in about 6% of trials besides the C ones.
model_training: instances 1 = the folder's first persona, loose_leaf_tea. 5000 training trials; 3000 steps at
batch 10 is 30000 examples, six passes. data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold/ keeps the weights of
data/paper_minimum_threshold/, with new trials built for these shares.
model_estimating: 1000 estimation trials per checkpoint (one persona, so cheap) for a stable recovered rule;
shuffle_draws 0, since the shuffled-persona baseline needs at least two personas.
report_schema.samples_per_report 50: one persona, so each checkpoint's faithfulness rests on its samples alone.
Every question asked and every reply is kept in results/<run>/reports_raw_<tag>.jsonl.
model_hyperparameters: 3000 steps, a checkpoint saved and evaluated every 250 (12 points; only the last keeps its
optimizer state, save_optimizer last). The untrained model is not scored first
(baseline_before_training false since 2026-11-23: the base model is a control, see this group's README.md). Constant learning rate, as the earlier runs.
Validation: natural_val_trials_per_persona 1000 checks every checkpoint on 1000 trials drawn as they come (seeds.validation),
the same trials whatever the training mix, with accuracy logged per trial kind. val_trials_per_persona is then unused.
max_grad_norm 1.0: the gradient norm is capped before each AdamW step; train_log.csv records the size before the cap.
Build the data folder (once; already built):
python data/general/vector_dataset_constructor.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold_a.json
